edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the from address of the ERC20 transfer call.
msg.sender becomes the owner in the approve call.
msg.sender is passed as spender to _approve inside transferFrom.
_msgSender() gates the onlyOwner transferOwnership function.
setDevWallet gate compares _msgSender() to a hardcoded privileged address in the onlyDev modifier; this both initializes and redirects dev fees.
Only the owner (msg.sender) may call addLiquidity to configure the pair and enable trading.
Only the owner may invoke emergencyWithdraw to drain the contract USDC balance.
Only the owner may remove bans, triggering the unchecked ban counter decrement.
Only the owner may toggle the anti-bot flag.
Only the owner may reassign the external AntiBot contract address.
transfer delegates all logic to the internal _transfer function.
transferFrom delegates the value movement to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance through _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
manualBan bans an arbitrary address by calling _banSeller.
_transfer derives the applicable fee via _setFee before splitting the amount.
_transfer invokes _checkBot which performs external AntiBot calls and may ban users.
_transfer enforces the transaction cap through _checkTxLimit on restricted buys.
_transfer performs an external router swap via _tax before its own balance state updates, allowing reentrant observation of stale balances.
_transfer mutates recipient/sender/contract entries of m_Balances.
_transfer consumes the _amount parameter for fee math and balance updates.
_transfer consumes the _recipient parameter for cap and ban checks.
_transfer consumes the _sender parameter for balance debits and ban checks.
_feeAmount is derived from _amount via division and multiplication without safety guarantees.
_newAmount is computed by subtracting the fee from _amount.
The fee amount is subtracted from the transferred amount to obtain the credited value.
The returned fee percentage multiplies the amount in the fee calculation.
The net amount is credited into the recipient balance slot.
_tax triggers the external swap routine while transfer state updates are still pending.
_swapTokensForUSDC performs the external router swap calls.
block.timestamp is supplied as the router swap deadline, making execution miner-timestamp dependent.
_checkBot obtains ban decisions from the external AntiBot.scanAddress call.
_checkBot calls _banSeller for addresses flagged by the scanner.
tx.origin is forwarded into _checkBot and used to ban the actual transaction originator.
The _origin parameter can be banned directly, extending bans to the transaction originator.
_banSeller writes the banned flag into m_Bots.
_banSeller increments m_BanCount on every newly banned address.
removeBan directly decrements the ban counter without a lower bound check.
The unchecked decrement operation mutates m_BanCount and can underflow.
emergencyWithdraw relies on an external USDC transferFrom to move funds.
addLiquidity performs an external router addLiquidity call with the whole balance.
addLiquidity calls the factory to create the trading pair.
addLiquidity approves the router to spend the contract USDC balance.
addLiquidity reads the USDC contract balance via m_USDC.
addLiquidity stores the newly created pair address in m_UniswapV2Pair.
addLiquidity assigns the router instance to m_UniswapV2Router.
addLiquidity enables tax swaps by setting m_SwapEnabled.
addLiquidity opens trading by setting m_TradingOpened.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline, introducing timestamp dependence.
_transfer notifies the external AntiBot contract about the processed block.
_tax consults _readyToTax before deciding to swap.
The swap precondition compares the contract balance against m_MinBalance.
_transfer gates fee/tax logic on the _pleb predicate.
_transfer checks _txRestricted to decide whether to enforce the per-transaction cap.
_transfer uses _walletCapped to decide whether to enforce the wallet limit.
_transfer queries balanceOf while validating caps.
_transfer compares the recipient balance against m_WalletLimit.
_checkTxLimit reads the recipient balance through balanceOf.
_checkTxLimit compares balance plus amount against m_WalletLimit.
_setFee writes the fee percentage into m_DevFee.
_setFee reads the exclusion mapping to decide the fee.
The boolean result of the external scan drives the ban decision in _banSeller.
banCount exposes the current value of m_BanCount.
checkIfBanned reads the bot flag from m_Bots.
_swapTokensForUSDC sets the m_IsSwap lock flag through the lockTheSwap modifier.
The fee-on-transfer router swap calls back into the token transfer logic while the swap lock only guards the swap routine itself.
_readyToTax requires m_SwapEnabled to be true.
_readyToTax requires the swap lock m_IsSwap to be false.
setProjectDevelopmentWallet assigns the new project development wallet.
setProjectDevelopmentWallet excludes the new wallet from fees.
setDevWallet flips the initialization gate m_Intialized.
setDevWallet assigns the dev fee recipient address.
assignAntiBot replaces the stored external AntiBot reference.
emergencyWithdraw sends the rescued USDC balance to _msgSender().
toggleAntiBot flips and returns the m_AntiBot state flag.
The address returned by the factory createPair call is stored as the pair.

normalization_plan.reason: The _amount parameter only exists to feed the _transfer balance and fee math; collapse it into _transfer.
The _recipient parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer cap and ban checks; collapse it into _transfer.
The _sender parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer; collapse it into _transfer.
The _origin parameter is consumed solely by _checkBot when deciding bans; collapse it into _checkBot.
The _fee local is produced by _setFee and merely relays the fee percentage; collapse it into _setFee.
The _feeAmount local is derived and consumed entirely within _transfer; collapse it into _transfer.
The _newAmount local is derived and consumed entirely within _transfer; collapse it into _transfer.
The _path array is constructed and used only inside _swapTokensForUSDC; collapse it into that function.
The _devFee local is computed and spent only within _swapTokensForUSDC; collapse it into that function.
The _tokenBalance local is read only inside _tax to size the swap; collapse it into _tax.
The _localBool local only reflects the toggled state returned by toggleAntiBot; collapse it into toggleAntiBot.
The _a parameter names the target of manual ban/unban operations and only feeds _banSeller; collapse it into manualBan.
